text:
Maya (Support): bumping CS 1 026-04-12 - seeing a burst of provisioning failures for several trials (NimbusHealth, SolsticeAI). Customers stuck in "pending_activation" and frontend shows spinner indefinitely. Raising as renewal-risk for Nimbus (renewal in 4d).

Diego (CS): thanks Maya. Can you paste recent error ids and any correlated spike graphs? We need to draft a customer note and a short remediation plan.

Maya (Support): logs: 
```
2026-04-12T14:02:11Z ERROR limiter: tenant_rate_exceeded tenant=nimbus req=req_9b2a
2026-04-12T14:02:13Z ERROR provisioner: attempt 3 failed -> 429 request=req_9b2b tenant=solstice
2026-04-12T14:02:15Z INFO webhook: retry scheduled -> beacon retry_count=1
```
Also SLO graph shows provisioning QPS spike x4 vs baseline at 14:00 UTC.

Ayesha (CS Ops): tagged this in CRM as renewal-risk:nimbus. Diego, want a template to send? I can also run a targeted runbook to fast-track high-touch tenants.

Diego (CS): yes please. Keep it transparent but calm. Ask if theyve tried reloading and offer a live session. Offer 7 extra trial days if not resolved within 24h.

Liam (Sales): heads-up I'll be on the Nimbus renewal call tomorrow. Please loop me if we need to agree credits.

infra-bot: We detected a rate-limiter misconfiguration from a recent deploy. Hotfix queued: bump tenant burst limit for affected tenants and rollback faulty rule. Expected mitigation in ~20m.

Maya (Support): Temporary unblock: support can execute manual bypass for VIP tenants via admin command. Steps: 
```
# admin-run
./admin tools set-burst --tenant <tenant_id> --value 500
./admin tools trigger-provision --tenant <tenant_id>
```
Use with caution; audit log records the admin id.

Ayesha (CS Ops): I'll prepare a short customer message. Draft below 1 please review: 

"Hi <Customer>, quick update: we experienced an internal provisioning rate limit issue affecting activations. Our engineers deployed a hotfix and we are running targeted re-provisions for affected accounts. If you'd like, we can schedule a 15-min troubleshooting session to confirm your instance is fully active. We're also extending your trial by 7 days proactively due to the interruption. Apologies and thanks for your patience"

Diego (CS): solid. Add one sentence promising a follow-up once we've validated their tenant. Also mention who to contact for immediate help.

Liam (Sales): please cc me on the Nimbus note. If we need legal sign-off for a formal credit, ping me and I'll coordinate.

Maya (Support): patch rolled. burst limits bumped for 12 tenants. Reprovision success rate now ~96% over last 10m. Still seeing a few 429s for long-tail tenants; continuing monitoring.

Ayesha (CS Ops): action items: 1) Diego send outreach to Nimbus+Solstice; 2) Ayesha run re-provision batch for flagged tenants and attach runbook; 3) Maya continue watching infra and post final recovery; 4) Liam join renewal call & hold credit/extension negotiation. I'll file a short post-incident note in /docs/cs/incidents.

Diego (CS): on it. I'll send the note in 15m and set a 10:30am CET check-in with Sales. Thanks all. :handshake:
